note: Validated legacy identities. Compatibility retains original receipts and exact archived sources; reviewed changes are generic GPT routing for existing original IDs, paging branches disabled in inline cases, and fixture-only ZCode paging.

source_review.deepseek-harness.mjs: Earlier code hardcoded GPT-6.1 routing. Generic GPT selection gives the same options for the recorded DeepSeek and GPT-6.1 IDs. New GPT results already used the generic adapter.
source_review.dispatch.py: Provider dispatch extracted from the recorded coordinator with identical command/adapter selection and failure handling; the additional offline guard refuses network launches. Its hash is now an inference dependency, distinct from scheduling code.
source_review.policy: Bindings are limited to these 55 exact task hashes, verified original fingerprints, complete receipts and exact archived sources. Any subsequent effective adapter or input change fails closed.
source_review.rea-gateway.mjs: Earlier inline cases have no evidence_paging config; the added pager branch is inactive. Paged results already used the current gateway.
source_review.zcode.py: The added evidence_paging field is inside the offline replay fixture branch; live behavior is unchanged.
